raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A DFlash draft keeps context K/V for every draft layer, so its KV pool costs `num_draft_layers` layers per token.
A shared context K/V draft computes one context K/V from the target hidden states, and every draft layer attends to it.
Its pool then holds one layer per token, and the freed memory goes to the target's KV cache.

## Modifications

- `dflash_config.shared_context_kv: true` in the draft config turns it on. Checkpoints carry `shared_context_kv.{input_norm,kv_proj,k_norm}.weight`.
- `DFlashSharedContextKV.write_context_kv` replaces the "target hidden -> per-layer context K/V" step: RMSNorm over the concatenated target features, one projection to [K | V], RMSNorm on each K head, RoPE, then one write as layer 0. It follows `DFlashMLAAttention.write_context_kv`.
- The draft KV pool has one layer (`end_layer = 1`), every draft layer's `RadixAttention` uses layer 0, and the target-side KV budget counts one draft layer.
- `DFlashAttention`, `project_target_hidden` and the per-layer write path are unchanged, so existing drafts behave as before. TP and quantized drafts are handled as for `fc`.
- New unit test: `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_shared_context_kv.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

Muse-Glimmer-30B target, one B300, TP1, `python -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions 1319` (5-shot, T=0, 32 parallel):

| Draft | GSM8K accuracy | Invalid |
|---|---|---|
| Released per-layer draft (`incoai/Muse-Glimmer-30B-DFlash2`) | 0.919 | 0.000 |
| Shared context K/V draft (`z-lab/Muse-Glimmer-30B-DFlash2-SharedKV`) | 0.919 | 0.000 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Muse-Glimmer-30B target, one B300, TP1, `--mem-fraction-static 0.8`, `--max-running-requests 32`, T=0.
Baseline: the released per-layer draft `incoai/Muse-Glimmer-30B-DFlash2` (5 layers, block 16).
Shared context K/V draft: [`z-lab/Muse-Glimmer-30B-DFlash2-SharedKV`](https://huggingface.co/z-lab/Muse-Glimmer-30B-DFlash2-SharedKV).

### 1. Draft KV memory

| | Released draft (per-layer K/V) | Shared context K/V draft |
|---|---|---|
| Draft K/V per token (bf16) | 20 KiB | 4 KiB |
| Draft KV pool | 47.4 GB | 12.7 GB |
| Target KV pool | 104.7 GB | 139.8 GB |
| Max tokens | 2,483,584 | 3,316,992 (+33.6%) |

### 2. Accept length and throughput

The shared-KV checkpoint was tuned from the released draft, not trained from scratch with the released draft's recipe, so accept length differs per dataset; this is not an architecture-only ablation.

Concurrency 32 (512 prompts per dataset):

| Dataset | Accept, released | Accept, shared KV | Throughput (tok/s), released | Throughput (tok/s), shared KV |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| gsm8k | 6.745 | 6.525 | 5,025 | 5,022 |
| math500 | 6.802 | 6.687 | 5,484 | 5,438 |
| humaneval | 5.930 | 6.061 | 5,230 | 5,330 |
| mbpp | 5.561 | 5.623 | 4,987 | 4,998 |
| mt-bench | 4.590 | 4.531 | 3,697 | 3,638 |
| Agentic traces (SWE, ~37k tokens each) | 7.82 | 7.71 | 2,203 | 2,210 |

Concurrency 1 (128 prompts per dataset):

| Dataset | Accept, released | Accept, shared KV | Throughput (tok/s), released | Throughput (tok/s), shared KV |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| gsm8k | 6.728 | 6.417 | 437 | 422 |
| math500 | 6.480 | 6.383 | 426 | 419 |
| humaneval | 5.826 | 5.929 | 418 | 423 |
| mbpp | 5.503 | 5.555 | 394 | 399 |
| mt-bench | 4.694 | 4.632 | 301 | 296 |

The agentic row replays multi-turn agent traces with 48 concurrent sessions (32 requests in flight, 64 output tokens per turn), where both drafts' caches fit.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+class DFlashSharedContextKV(nn.Module):
+    """Target hidden -> the context K/V that every draft layer reads, written once
+    as layer 0: RMSNorm over the target features, one projection to [K | V],
+    RMSNorm on each K head (V is not normed), then the layers' RoPE on K."""
+
+    def __init__(self, features, attn, norm_cls, eps, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.head_dim = attn.head_dim
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = attn.total_num_kv_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = attn.num_kv_heads
+        # This rank's K/V heads, sharded as DFlashAttention shards them.
+        tp_size, tp_rank = int(get_parallel().tp_size), int(get_parallel().tp_rank)
+        if self.total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            self.kv_head_start = tp_rank * self.num_kv_heads
+        else:
+            self.kv_head_start = tp_rank // (tp_size // self.total_num_kv_heads)
+        self.input_norm = norm_cls(features, eps=eps)
+        self.kv_proj = ReplicatedLinear(
+            features,
+            2 * self.total_num_kv_heads * self.head_dim,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.kv_proj",
+        )
+        self.k_norm = norm_cls(self.head_dim, eps=eps)
+
+    def write_context_kv(
+        self,
+        *,
+        attn: DFlashAttention,
+        pool,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        target_hidden: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_loc_2d: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        commit_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """With cache_loc_2d, writes only each request's first commit_lens rows."""
+        # The native path reduces the wide input (all target layers) in fp32.
+        kv, _ = self.kv_proj(self.input_norm.forward_native(target_hidden))
+        n = int(target_hidden.shape[0])
+        heads = slice(self.kv_head_start, self.kv_head_start + self.num_kv_heads)
+        kv = kv.view(n, 2, self.total_num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)[:, :, heads]
+        k = self.k_norm(kv[:, 0].reshape(-1, self.head_dim)).view(n, -1)
+        k = attn.apply_k_rope(positions, k).view(n, -1, self.head_dim)
+        v = kv[:, 1].contiguous()
+        if attn.v_scale is not None:
+            v = v * attn.v_scale
+        layer = attn.attn
+        if cache_loc_2d is None:
+            pool.layer_router.layer(layer.layer_id).store(
+                layer,
+                KVWriteLoc(cache_loc, physical=True),
+                k,
+                v,
+                layer.k_scale,
+                layer.v_scale,
+            )
+        else:
+            pool.set_kv_buffer_prefix_valid(
+                layer, cache_loc_2d, commit_lens, k, v, layer.k_scale, layer.v_scale
+            )
+

+"""DFlash shared context K/V drafts: one projection writes the context K/V that
+every draft layer reads, kept in a one-layer draft pool."""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import torch
+from transformers import Qwen3Config
+
+from sglang.srt.models.dflash import DFlashDraftModel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import reset_context
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_utils import parse_dflash_draft_config
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.parallel_groups import publish
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+HIDDEN, HEADS, KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, LAYERS, EPS = 32, 4, 2, 8, 3, 1e-6
+TARGET_LAYER_IDS = [0, 1]
+FEATURES = len(TARGET_LAYER_IDS) * HIDDEN
+
+
+def _config(**overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        architectures=["DFlashDraftModel"],
+        hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+        intermediate_size=64,
+        num_hidden_layers=LAYERS,
+        num_attention_heads=HEADS,
+        num_key_value_heads=KV_HEADS,
+        head_dim=HEAD_DIM,
+        vocab_size=64,
+        rms_norm_eps=EPS,
+        rope_theta=1e4,
+        max_position_embeddings=4096,
+        dflash_config={
+            "block_size": 4,
+            "target_layer_ids": TARGET_LAYER_IDS,
+            "shared_context_kv": True,
+        },
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return Qwen3Config(**fields)
+
+
+def _rmsnorm(x, weight):
+    return x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS) * weight
+
+
+class TestDFlashSharedContextKV(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        reset_context()
+        self.addCleanup(reset_context)
+        # CPU CI does not enable the CPU engine; keep RoPE on the native path.
+        self.enterContext(
+            patch("sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding.base._is_cpu", True)
+        )
+        publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", device="cuda", tp_size=1), role="test")
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+    def _model(self, **overrides):
+        model = DFlashDraftModel(_config(**overrides))
+        for param in model.shared_context_kv.parameters():
+            param.data.normal_()
+        return model
+
+    def test_parse(self):
+        config = {"num_hidden_layers": 2, "dflash_config": {"shared_context_kv": True}}
+        self.assertTrue(
+            parse_dflash_draft_config(draft_hf_config=config).shared_context_kv
+        )
+        config = {"num_hidden_layers": 2, "dflash_config": {}}
+        self.assertFalse(
+            parse_dflash_draft_config(draft_hf_config=config).shared_context_kv
+        )
+
+    def test_one_pool_layer_and_no_fc(self):
+        model = self._model()
+        self.assertEqual(model.end_layer, 1)
+        self.assertEqual({l.self_attn.attn.layer_id for l in model.layers}, {0})
+        self.assertFalse(hasattr(model, "fc") or hasattr(model, "hidden_norm"))
+        self.assertFalse(model.supports_fused_context_kv)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {
+                n
+                for n, _ in model.named_parameters()
+                if n.startswith("shared_context_kv.")
+            },
+            {
+                "shared_context_kv.input_norm.weight",
+                "shared_context_kv.kv_proj.weight",
+                "shared_context_kv.k_norm.weight",
+            },
+        )
+
+    def test_load_weights(self):
+        model = self._model()
+        checkpoint = {
+            "shared_context_kv.input_norm.weight": torch.randn(FEATURES),
+            "shared_context_kv.kv_proj.weight": torch.randn(
+                2 * KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM, FEATURES
+            ),
+            "shared_context_kv.k_norm.weight": torch.randn(HEAD_DIM),
+        }
+        model.load_weights(checkpoint.items())
+        params = dict(model.named_parameters())
+        for name, weight in checkpoint.items():
+            torch.testing.assert_close(params[name], weight, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_write_matches_reference(self):
+        model = self._model()
+        shared, attn = model.shared_context_kv, model.layers[0].self_attn
+        n = 5
+        target_hidden = torch.randn(n, FEATURES)
+        positions = torch.arange(n) + 7
+
+        x = _rmsnorm(target_hidden, shared.input_norm.weight)
+        kv = (x @ shared.kv_proj.weight.T).view(n, 2, KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
+        k = _rmsnorm(kv[:, 0], shared.k_norm.weight).reshape(n, -1)
+        k = attn.apply_k_rope(positions, k).view(n, KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
+        v = kv[:, 1]
+
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            pool = Mock()
+            shared.write_context_kv(
+                attn=attn,
+                pool=pool,
+                positions=positions,
+                target_hidden=target_hidden,
+                cache_loc=torch.arange(n),
+            )
+            pool.layer_router.layer.assert_called_once_with(0)
+            args = pool.layer_router.layer.return_value.store.call_args.args
+            torch.testing.assert_close(args[2], k)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(args[3], v)
+
+            pool = Mock()
+            commit_lens = torch.tensor([3, 2], dtype=torch.int32)
+            shared.write_context_kv(
+                attn=attn,
+                pool=pool,
+                positions=positions,
+                target_hidden=target_hidden,
+                cache_loc=torch.arange(n),
+                cache_loc_2d=torch.arange(6).view(2, 3),
+                commit_lens=commit_lens,
+            )
+            args = pool.set_kv_buffer_prefix_valid.call_args.args
+            self.assertIs(args[0], attn.attn)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(args[3], k)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(args[4], v)
+
+    def test_layers_need_one_attention_window(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "one attention window"):
+            DFlashDraftModel(
+                _config(
+                    layer_types=[
+                        "sliding_attention",
+                        "full_attention",
+                        "sliding_attention",
+                    ],
+                    sliding_window=16,
+                    use_sliding_window=True,
+                )
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
